claim_text: **The Apacheta for Tensor Infrastructure**: The `yanantin/apacheta` directory seems to be the heart of the "composable tensor infrastructure." It contains modules for backends (`arango.py`, `duckdb.py`, `memory.py`), clients (`openrouter.py`), models (`tensor.py`, `composition.py`), and operators (`bootstrap.py`, `compose.py`, `correct.py`, `evolve.py`).
